what_changed_from_v1: Same rule_rain60 model, refitted on the 58 verified 2017-2023 floods (v1: 36). The budget rule (unchanged: 2.5 false High, 11 false Moderate episodes per zone-year) now puts Moderate at 0.531% instead of 0.30%; High stays at 0.706%.
test_result_note: The published 2024-2026 test result (High 12/30, Moderate 21/30 at 0.30%) was measured once with version 1 and does not describe version 3. Scoring version 3 on 2024-2026 would be a 'second look'.
